title: 第5章 慕容雪第6章 九阳灭世诀
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 要知道今日徐墨的变化，让她有些始料未及。
她还在想下个月的圣丹应该如何得到呢。
结果，叶峰居然说以后一周都需要两颗圣丹，要知道那可是圣丹啊，可不是路边的大白菜！
为了这个月的圣丹，她今天可是足足被…四个小时。
这要是以后一周就需要两颗圣丹，难不成她还要被……
不过，她毕竟已经不是完壁了，已经被徐墨拿下了，她现在对徐墨的价值和诱惑自然没有第一次那么大了。
再加上现在的圣丹需求变大，提升到每周两颗，徐墨定然不会放过自己，恐怕会提出更离谱的要求。
想到这，柳如烟便感到浑身不寒而栗，一股绝望涌上心头。
“如烟妹妹，我真的很想活着，跟你永远在一起。”
这时候，叶峰接着又说道。
听到此话，柳如烟紧绷的身体慢慢放松，似乎做出了什么决定，轻轻点了点头，“好，我知道了，我会把圣丹弄到手的。”
看着一脸悲凉的叶峰，柳如烟的内心非常痛。
纵使再被徐墨那样又如何，为了叶哥哥，为了他们的未来，这些都值得。
而叶峰在听到柳如烟答应后，嘴角微微上扬，眼眸深处闪过一丝惊喜。
同时也在心里暗暗决定，“如烟妹妹，待我突破到合体，我就把一切都告诉你，跟你表白。
到时，我们就可以做一对人人羡慕的神仙眷侣了。”
至于那个徐墨，呵呵，不过是如烟妹妹的舔狗罢了，还想癞蛤蟆吃天鹅肉，真是痴心妄想。
他纵使付出得再多，也永远得不到如烟妹妹。
一想到徐墨给柳如烟献殷勤的那副样子，叶峰就十分想笑。
但是话说回来，他自今天开始，总感觉头发痒痒的，好像有什么东西要长出来，这种感觉很奇特。
还有就是今天的圣丹，虽说功效和之前的一般无二，但是自从服下后，他的身体便怪怪的，好像多了什么东西。
不过叶峰把这一切都归于过度兴奋产生的幻觉。
没错，一定是幻觉。
与此同时。
徐墨已经来到一处幽静的山谷中。
山谷呈环状，谷中有一圆形湖心岛，岛上建有一间冰蓝色的水晶房屋，十分漂亮。
不过让徐墨奇怪的是，之前山清水秀的湖心岛，此刻竟变成了冰湖，连带着整个山谷的温度都变得极低。
就连已是太阳圣体的徐墨，都被这股寒气冻得有些发抖。
徐墨纵身来到水晶屋前，轻轻敲了敲，轻声问道，“师尊，您在吗？”
等了几秒后，发现房间里并没有回应，也没有传出什么声响。
徐墨眉头一皱，又敲了敲房门。
但是和刚才一样，还是没有人回应，这让他的眉头皱得更深了。
难道师尊今天碰巧不在？
在犹豫了片刻后，徐墨还是决定进屋看一眼，接着他伸手推开房门。
在推开房门的瞬间，一股浓郁至极的寒气扑面而来，仅仅一个呼吸的时间，徐墨的身上就覆盖了一层冰霜。
然而徐墨似乎并没受到任何影响，反而呆呆地站在原地，直勾勾地看着前方。
原因无他。
此刻，原本在他记忆中清冷高贵的绝美师尊，此时竟只穿着一身单薄的心衣，盘坐在他面前的冰床之上。
如雪般白皙的肌肤暴露在空气中，让人忍不住浮想联翩。
冰蓝色的心衣半遮着身姿，勾勒出傲人的曲线，也盖住了自身的汹涌，一缕淡蓝色发丝飘落在精致的锁骨之上，为她清冷高贵的气质上增添一丝妩媚。
美得如仙女般惊心动魄的面容上，已布满密集的香汗，眉头紧皱，似乎在忍受着什么痛苦。
徐墨很快就察觉到了不对劲，连忙运转九重天眼，查看起慕容雪的面板。

You must know that Xu Mo's changes today were a bit unexpected for her.
She was still thinking about how to get next month's elixir.
As a result, Ye Feng actually said that he would need two Holy Pills every week from now on. You must know that those are Holy Pills, not cabbage on the roadside!
For this month's holy elixir, she had been...for four hours today.
If two Holy Pills are needed in the next week, is it possible that she will be...
However, after all, she was no longer dead, and had been captured by Xu Mo. Naturally, her value and temptation to Xu Mo now were not as great as they were the first time.
In addition, the demand for holy pills has increased now, increasing to two pills per week. Xu Mo will definitely not let him go, and he may make even more outrageous demands.
Thinking of this, Liu Ruyan felt shuddering all over, and a feeling of despair surged into her heart.
"Sister Ruyan, I really want to live and be with you forever."
At this time, Ye Feng continued.
After hearing this, Liu Ruyan's tense body slowly relaxed, as if he had made some decision, and nodded slightly, "Okay, I understand, I will get the Holy Pill."
Looking at Ye Feng with a sad face, Liu Ruyan felt very painful in her heart.
So what if Xu Mo does that again, for Brother Ye and for their future, it's all worth it.
After Ye Feng heard Liu Ruyan's agreement, the corners of his mouth raised slightly, and a hint of surprise flashed deep in his eyes.
At the same time, I also secretly decided in my heart, "Sister Ruyan, when I break through to integration, I will tell you everything and confess to you.
By then, we can be a couple of gods and goddesses that everyone envies. "
As for that Xu Mo, haha, he is just sister Ruyan's licking dog. He still wants to eat swan meat. What a wishful thinking.
No matter how much he pays, he will never get sister Ruyan.
Ye Feng wanted to laugh when he thought of the way Xu Mo was showing courtesy to Liu Ruyan.
But having said that, since today, he has been feeling itchy on his head, as if something is about to grow. This feeling is very strange.
There is also today's holy elixir. Although its efficacy is the same as before, his body has been acting strange since taking it, as if there is something extra.
However, Ye Feng attributed all this to hallucinations caused by excessive excitement.
Yes, it must be an illusion.
at the same time.
Xu Mo has arrived in a quiet valley.
The valley is ring-shaped, and there is a circular island in the center of the lake. There is an ice blue crystal house built on the island, which is very beautiful.
But what surprised Xu Mo was that the island in the center of the lake, which had beautiful mountains and clear waters before, turned into a glacial lake, and the temperature of the entire valley became extremely low.
Even Xu Mo, who was already the holy body of the sun, was trembling a little due to the cold air.
Xu Mo jumped up to the crystal house, knocked it gently, and asked softly, "Master, are you there?"
After waiting for a few seconds, he found that there was no response or any sound coming from the room.
Xu Mo frowned and knocked on the door again.
But just like before, there was still no response, which made his frown deepen.
Could it be that Master is not here today by chance?
After hesitating for a moment, Xu Mo decided to go in and take a look, then he reached out and pushed open the door.
The moment he opened the door, a strong and extremely cold air hit his face. In just one breath, Xu Mo's body was covered with a layer of frost.
However, Xu Mo didn't seem to be affected in any way. Instead, he stood there blankly, looking straight ahead.
There is no other reason.
At this moment, the beautiful master who was originally cold and noble in his memory was actually wearing only a thin inner garment and sitting cross-legged on the ice bed in front of him.
The skin as white as snow is exposed to the air, making people unable to help but think about it.
The ice-blue heartsuit half-covered her figure, outlining her proud curves and covering her own turbulence. A strand of light blue hair fell on her delicate collarbone, adding a touch of charm to her cold and noble temperament.
Her breathtaking face, as beautiful as a fairy, was covered with dense fragrant sweat, and her brows were furrowed, as if she was enduring some pain.
Xu Mo quickly noticed something was wrong, and quickly ran the Nine Heavenly Eyes to check Murong Xue's panel.
